description: This file defines REST API endpoints for managing events, including creation, retrieval, listing, updating, and deletion, with validation of event times and capacity constraints. It uses FastAPI for routing, SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions, and includes business rules enforcement for event timing.

methods.name: _validate_event_times(start_time: datetime, end_time: datetime)
methods.description: Validates that the end_time is after the start_time; raises HTTPException if invalid.

methods.name: create_event( payload: EventCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Creates a new event after validating the start and end times.

methods.name: list_events( db: Session = Depends(get_db), q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Search query for title"), skip: int = Query(default=0, ge=0, description="Pagination offset"), limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100, description="Pagination limit"), )
methods.description: Returns a paginated list of events, optionally filtered by a search query.

methods.name: get_event(event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event by its ID.

methods.name: update_event( event_id: int, payload: EventUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Updates an existing event, enforcing time and capacity rules.

methods.name: delete_event( event_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Deletes an event and its associated attendees.
